property_rnav.rationale: Shared property RNAV policy that applies scenario-specific realization and tax leakage to the disclosed investment-property fair-value uplift.

premium_holdco.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for a large, liquid holding company with diversified recurring earnings.

diversified_holdco.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen with an explicit conglomerate discount while full component SOTP remains unresolved.

income_holdco.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for an income-oriented holding company with material commodity and cyclical exposure.

premium_property.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for a scaled property platform with a large recurring-income portfolio.

diversified_property.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for diversified property developers pending property-level RNAV reconciliation.

deep_discount_property.rationale: Shared deep-discount P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for a leveraged property developer pending property-level RNAV reconciliation.

growth_property.rationale: Shared P/B-to-reported-NAV screen for a regional growth property platform pending property-level RNAV reconciliation.
